guidelines: kansō removes information, never options. Every action stays one press away.
At rest, show only what the user would miss. Every fact has one home; a second place is a defect.
Colour marks a state, never decoration. Only the ensō spin, the working shimmer and a blocked bar move.

pages.page: Tokens/Kit: every value and every element, once
guidelines: Every page and every mod uses these tokens and pieces. A value outside the kit, or a piece drawn twice, is a defect.
Type roles: Display 48 regular. Title 20 strong. Section 15 strong. Group 13.5 strong. Name 13.5 medium. Body 12.5 regular; controls 12.5 medium. Meta 11.5 regular, muted or dim.
Space: 2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32 only. Icon to label 8. Control to control 8. Rows touch. Groups and fields 12 apart. Panel padding 16.

Controls: buttons and fields 30 high, 12.5, 12 inside. Kinds: solid (the one primary), tonal (7% foreground fill, no edge), quiet (text only) and armed. A field label sits 8 above it, 12.5 medium muted. A one-line state or toast ends with its action, 24 high, 8 inside.

Washes from the foreground: track 4%, hover 7%, selected 12%. Hover changes tone only, in 120 ms, out 80 ms. Press uses the selected wash. Focus is a 2 px accent ring outside the box. Disabled controls take no hover.
Armed: only an action that cannot be undone asks twice. It fills with accent and reads "Press again to <verb>" for 4 s. Both labels share one cell.
Motion: the ensō spins at 900 ms; a working name shimmers with three glints over 2200 ms; a blocked pane's bar breathes. Reduced motion holds everything still.
Icons: exact Lucide, one name per meaning, at 12, 14, 15 or 17.
Light and dark share geometry; only tokens change. Text 4.5:1, edges 3:1 in both. Light is never pure white.
One drawing per state, in the same words at every size.

Sidebar failure is a word on the row: icon, name, the state (11.5 dim) and the fix as a row button at the end (20 with 12). No block under a row. The source's words, other fixes and Explain to <agent> live in the row's right-click menu.

Panel failure block: 1 px blocked edge, no fill, radius 8, 12 inside. A 14 mark, our words (13.5 medium), then the source's words (mono 11.5 muted, two lines max; full text on hover when cut). Buttons 30 high, 8 below, sharing the text width: the fix first, solid; then Explain to <agent>, tonal, with the Lucide bot icon and the agent named in words. The row above does not repeat the state.
The block sits where the list would start; a refused write sits 2 under its row. In the sidebar a refused write is a toast and the row returns to its state before the press.
Toast failure: mark, our words, the fix at the end, 24 high. A click on the line does the fix. No Explain.
Bar failure (status bar 26, pane header 34): mark, our words, then the fix as a quiet button 20 high with no edge.
Empty: centred, 24 above and below: the view's icon (20, dim), one sentence (12.5 muted) and at most one tonal button.
Pending: the new state draws at once at 80% with a 4 px muted dot breathing beside it. Confirmed, both go. Refused, the old state returns with the failure block.
Blocked colour only on the edge and the mark; words stay foreground and muted.
This list is the only icon set. A new icon comes from Lucide 1.72.0 (ISC), markup unchanged, added here with an lu- id and its meaning before use.
24 grid, stroke 2, round caps and joins. Ids are lu- plus the Lucide name.
One name per meaning: lu-x close, lu-ellipsis more, one pin, one sync, one share, one layers, one terminal. A plain shell is lu-terminal.
Marks, not icons: the ensō marks and spinner, the blocked mark, the Claude Code and Codex marks, Hachi's pixel art, the Dawn artwork, the kansō wordmark, the macOS window lights, the pointer.
Android has no Lucide icon (open: the word "Android" on the button). iOS uses lu-apple.
Every colour is a token from the table. A new colour enters the table, with its use, before anything uses it.
Text 4.5:1 on every surface it can sit on, hover and selected included. Marks, focus rings and control edges 3:1. No opacity on text.
Three text levels: fg, muted, dim.
A state colour appears only on the thing in that state.
Washes from the foreground: track 4%, hover 7%, selected 12%, active project 14%. Light never reaches pure white or black.
Light and dark share geometry and token names; only values differ. A token change is checked against every surface, hover and selected included.

| Fact | Its one home | Also shown, and why | Never shown in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| An agent needs you | Its sidebar row: blocked wash, mark and the question. | Status bar, only while the row is out of view. | Pane header and tab. A dot on the view switch or the rail. A "Needs you" card. |
| What it asks | Its sidebar row's tooltip and its pane. | Status bar, only while the row is off screen, same words and cut. | A second, longer copy. |
| An agent finished, and its last words | Its pane. The row shows the done mark until you look. | Nowhere else. | A digest on the done row. |
| What the turn changed: files, diff | Pane header segments. | Nowhere else. A file's own stat in Files is a different fact. | A total in Files. The same numbers on the sidebar row. |
| This agent is working | Its sidebar row: spinning ensō and name shimmer. | Nowhere else. | Pane header and tabs. Edge dots. |
| How many agents are working | The spinning rows; the Status view lists them. | Nowhere else. | A count on the status bar or footer. |
| A command still running after the turn | The agent's row, by name ("pnpm dev"). | Nowhere else while Ports is closed. | A bare number. |
| The project's branch | Project row. A worktree's name is its branch. | Nowhere else. | Pane header. Status bar. |
| Commits not pushed | Project row ↑N; a click opens Push. | Nowhere else. | Pane header "N commits". Arrows that do nothing. |
| Behind upstream | Project row ↓N; a press pulls. | Nowhere else. "Behind main" on a PR is its base, in the header verdict. | Arrows that do nothing. |
| Pull request state | Pane header: #N and its verdict in words. | The PR panel holds the detail when open. | A dot without words. |
| A check failed | The same pane header segment. | Away card or toast, only when no header in view shows that PR. | The done row. |
| Reviews asked of me | PR list, first group, "Asked of you". | Status bar "2 reviews"; a click opens that group. | A count pill in the list. |
| A kansō update exists | The Settings menu in the footer, in words. | Toast, only while the footer is out of view. | A dot on the gear or footer. A banner in Settings. |
| Herdr has an update | The Settings menu, "Update Herdr". | Nowhere else. | "Settings · update ready". |
| Which channel I am on | The sidebar header band, the pill, or nothing. | Nowhere else. | Toasts, the footer. |
| A computer's name | Its row at the head of its projects. | Nowhere else. | The status bar. A row for the only computer. |
| A computer stopped answering | Said once: the away card, or a toast while you are here. | Its actions stay under + → Computers. | A standing "Unreachable" or "Off" on the list or status bar. |
| Memory is low | Status bar, "Memory 8% free". | A system notice in the same words, only while no kansō window is on screen. | The status bar while the Memory panel is open. |
| A tab is asleep | The Asleep group; folded, its count. | Nowhere else. | A second list in the Sleep dialog. A count beside open rows. |
| Could not sleep | The asleep row: reason, Retry, Undo. | Toast in the same words, only while the group is off screen. | The toast while the group is in view. |
| What happened while you were away | The away card: only facts no row in view shows. | Nowhere else. | Needs you or Finished for a row in view. A count. |
| A server with no pane | Status bar ":6006 no pane"; a click opens Ports on that row. | Nowhere else. | The status bar while Ports is open. A second line in Ports. |
| A container failed | Its row in Containers: "exited 1 · 3 min". | Status bar "api-db exited 1", only while the panel is closed. | Hero counts. "Docker is not installed". |
| Spend | The Spend panel, one number. | Nowhere else. | A dollar amount on the status bar. |
| A file the agent named | Files, "Named by checkout". | Nowhere else. | A second listing under Also changed. |
| The command palette key | Settings · Keys, the one list of every key. | Nowhere else. | The status bar. A second keyboard in Help. |
The status bar or a toast may carry a fact only while its home is off screen or closed, and drops it when the home returns.
Before adding anything visible, find its fact here. A new fact gets a row with its home before it is drawn.
Facts you already know and cannot act on are said once, when they happen.
Every piece answers a right-click. A piece can be put away and comes back from the same place.

Menu order: a title naming the piece (Pull request · #166), the piece's own actions, a rule, then Only when needed, Hide this, Settings for this…. Rows with their own menu (agent, project, tab) keep their actions on top and end with these three.
Only when needed shows the piece only while it has something to say. Hide this hides it until brought back. Settings for this… opens Settings at that piece's switch.
Hide this acts at once. A toast names what left and what stops with it ("Hidden: Pull request"); its one action is Undo, for 8 s.
Neighbours close the gap; nothing jumps while the menu is open.
It is the kit menu. A terminal's own right-click stays the terminal's.
Bring a piece back from a right-click on its region or from Settings · Pieces, the one list of everything hidden.
Drawn from the app as it is (kanso-spaces, kanso-chrome, kanso-tabs, kanso-strip, kanso-status): same regions, controls and places.
Grid: a lead is 15 and its name 8 after, so each level steps 23 (8, 31, 54). Rows 32, 50 with a second line; groups 12 apart.

Sizes: chrome buttons (+, sort, search, hide, footer) 32 with 17. Bars (tabs, panels, pane tools) 26 with 15. Row buttons 20 with 12; row tails 12; marks 14. Names 13.5, tabs and headers 12.5, secondary 11.5. Radius 6 for controls, 8 for panes.
↓12 is a count: muted, not red. Blocked lives on the mark.
An agent's right-click sets What it is on, Time in its state and Commands still running to Show, Only when needed or Hide. At Only when needed, working and waiting sessions show a second line.
Title bar: the lights only. Footer: Update kansō while one is ready, then Settings, whose menu holds kansō settings, Herdr settings and Help.
Status bar: computer and branch left, minimap middle, − 2 + right.
The row folds; there is no chevron. Folded, it shows its most urgent mark and how many. The header shows the worktree by its last name, the full path on hover.

At rest a row is its lead, name and ensō. + and ⋯ appear on the row under the pointer. Pane tools beyond sleep and send appear over the header's right end. A panel button shows its name only while its panel is open.
Selection is one wash shared by the active project, tab and focused pane header.
Kept: dark "Off" with its power button, the Update row, the tree lines, every panel button.
Two modes, named everywhere: Stable Mode and Dawn Mode. Dawn Mode gets builds first.
The art is a dawn sky with the ensō as the sun. Five colours per theme: dawn-top, dawn-mid, dawn-low, dawn-edge, dawn-sun.
One home: the sidebar header, 56 high, behind the lights and above the tools.
It is a piece: Artwork (default in Dawn Mode), Pill ("Dawn Mode" right of the lights, tinted dawn-sun) or Hidden. Stable Mode shows nothing.
The sun rises once, when the window opens in Dawn Mode or on switching to it: the sky lightens over 2.6 s, then stays still. Reduced motion shows the final frame. Every copy plays together.
The switch's row says "It can break"; one press switches. A release that breaks something says so first in What's new.
Every row the app has, on the window grid: leads 15, names 8 after, levels every 23, rows 32 (50 with a second line), groups 12 apart.
At rest a row is its lead, name and ensō. A second line only for working or blocked, as the user chooses. + and ⋯ on the row under the pointer; the row folds.
A computer says its state in a word (Off, Unreachable) with its fix as a row button.
Asleep is one folded group with its count.
A row keeps its height and a name its width on hover, focus and state change.
Colour only on the mark. Counts (↓12, 2) are muted.
Title bar 48 high with the lights. Tools row 40: + at the left; sort, search and hide at the right. Chrome buttons 32 with 17, muted, foreground on hover, each with a tooltip.
+ is the same in every view: a conversation in a project you pick, then New project…, Open a folder…, Add computer….
Sort holds only orders. Away from its default it stays foreground and its tooltip names the order.
Search opens find in place. Hide folds the sidebar to the rail.
The kit segmented control, 30 high, under the tools row and 12 above the list, inset 8 each side. Track w4, chosen segment w12, no edge, 12.5 medium.
No dot: a waiting agent is said by its row and the status bar.
Keys in the tooltip: ⌃⌥P, ⌃⌥S, ⌃⌥T.
It is a piece: Hidden keeps Projects and the keys still work. Collapsed, the three are icons in the rail.
Project row 32: name 13.5 semibold, then folder, branch and ahead/behind, 11.5 dim with counts muted. No initial tile.
A worktree: branch mark as lead, name muted, one level under the project, no elbow. With one agent it is that agent's row, branch dim after the name; with none or several it keeps its own row.
↑N shows only while no pane of that place is in view. ↓N always shows.
+ stays on the active project; other rows show + and ⋯ on hover. Folded, a row shows its most urgent mark and how many.
↓N pulls on one press (git pull --ff-only, no arming): ↓N goes, a breathing dot shows, the tooltip says Pulling. A refusal brings ↓N back with a toast.
A failed read is a word on the row: Folder not found, with Locate; the path and Explain in right-click. Under an unreachable computer rows stay dim with when they were read.
Kept with nothing open is one muted row; a click asks which agent starts there. Double-click renames; Enter keeps, Esc leaves.
Cost: git status and rev-parse per place when a folder changes or a turn ends; remote places once a minute, in front only. Hidden git (sidebar.git) runs nothing.
Row 32: program icon 15 (a terminal uses lu-terminal), name 13.5 medium 8 after, ensō 14 at the right. 50 with a second line. One weight in every state.

Second line per right-click: What it is on, Time in its state, Commands still running, each Show, Only when needed or Hide. Default Only when needed: working or blocked shows what it is on · time; finished shows the count of commands still running; idle is its name.
Ink: working, blocked and focused foreground; finished and idle muted; sub-agent dim. Blocked shows on the ensō, never red.
On hover pin and ⋯ take the time's place. A pinned row keeps a 12 pin before its mark.
Sub-agents sit under their parent, joined by the tree line. Folded, the parent shows a sub-agent that needs you.
A terminal has no ensō. In Status and Threads the project (and a remote computer) follows the name in dim. Under an unreachable computer the row is dim with an idle ensō.
Cost: step and question come from Herdr's report (OSC 7501). Running commands: one local ps while an agent works, none when sidebar.tasks is hidden.
A computer row: icon 15 (monitor here, server remote), name 13.5 medium, state word at the right (11.5 dim), one fix as a row button 20 with 12. Its projects follow under it.

Off with power, Unreachable with Refresh, Needs login with Sign in (opens a terminal running hc machine login <name>). The source's words, other fixes and Explain in right-click. Opened, an unreachable computer shows its projects dim.
A computer that drops while you are here is a toast with Refresh, then the row says Unreachable.

Turn on is one press: the row is on and its projects show the skeleton until hc answers; a refusal turns it back with a toast. Connected, the row shows power, + and Sync on hover; Sync's mark stays while on.
Folded, the row shows the most urgent mark and project count. No projects: "No projects on <name> yet", New project. Double-click renames (an alias kept by kansō and carried by Sync).

Cost: hc machine ls every 30 s in front, 2 min behind; a dim computer read once a minute only while opened; one caffeinate hold per connected computer every 270 s; Sync once per 3 min per computer. Off: nothing.
Asleep is one folded row with its count. Open, rows are 32, one level in, name dim, Wake at the right as a quiet link. Enter wakes. The count shows only when folded.
Sleep and Wake are one press: the row moves and shows the breathing dot until it lands. Wake is the undo.
Could not sleep is a word on the row: Couldn't sleep, with Undo; the reason and Explain in right-click.
On an unreachable computer the row stays dim with when it was read, and no Wake. A tab asleep in an awake project is one row named by the tab, Wake N. A whole project asleep keeps its moon.
Cost: none at rest.
A raised card: radius 8, 1 px border, 4 inside. Nothing new takes zero space.
It docks at the foot of the list, 12 above the footer; no row moves when it comes or goes.

Title row 32: "While you were away" 13.5 semibold with × (20 with 12). Event rows 32 (50 with detail): icon 15 in its state colour, fact 12.5, detail 11.5 muted, time 11.5 dim. Four rows, then "+N more".
It lists only what nothing in view says: a merge, an approval, a red check out of view, an agent that slept or could not, an agent whose pane is gone.
A click opens the thing and drops the row. × dismisses all. Right-click: Dismiss these, then the piece lines; Hide this is the sidebar.away switch (Show, When needed, Hide).
Cost: none; events come from what kansō already reads, stored in the local database.

pages.page: Compositions/Needs you list: hidden by default
guidelines: Hidden by default (sidebar.needs). The row keeps its mark and question, the status bar names the oldest with +N while its row is out of view, Status opens on the same list, and ⌘J walks waiting agents.
Only waiting agents count; a finished agent says Finished on its row.
Shown, it is a section of the same rows headed by the mark and Needs you, project after each name in dim. Nobody waiting draws nothing.
Cost: none.
Sections: Needs you, Working, Done, Idle, Asleep, Terminals. Heads 32, 13.5 strong muted; Needs you keeps its mark. The head folds and shows its count. Idle, Asleep and Terminals start folded.
Rows are agent rows, flush at 8, with the project in dim (and a remote computer: ops · dark). The second line follows the user's choice.
Projects have no colours of their own.
Empty: the view's icon and one sentence, no action. First read: the skeleton at row height.
Sort: latest change, longest in its state, project.
Cost: none of its own.
A conversation is an agent row: program icon, title, ensō, 32. The second line is what it says now or "You: …", per the user's choice.
Grouped by project by default: head 32 in muted words, + on hover. Pinned first. Snoozed and Settled start folded with their count. A snoozed row's time is when it returns (Thu 9:00).
An ended snooze says Woke after the title, dim.
Unreadable: Can't read, with Refresh; details and Explain in right-click. Empty: the view's icon and one sentence.
On hover a finished row shows Settle (✓) and ⋯; Pin, Snooze and Mark unread are in the menu.
Cost: local transcripts read every 60 s (15 s while Threads is in front), only files that grew. Other computers' conversations are not read.
Search replaces the view switch with the kit field, 30 high, placeholder Find, esc at its right. Esc closes and restores the list. ⌘F and / open it too.
The list narrows to rows matching name, step, branch or folder; the project stays as context. Matched letters go foreground semibold.
The first match has the keyboard ring: Enter goes there, ↓ ↑ move.
Rows on other computers are included (dim when unreachable). No match: the search icon and one sentence with the query.
Cost: none; it filters what is drawn.

pages.page: Compositions/New project, new conversation, new worktree
guidelines: Every start ends in "New in kansō": agents installed on that computer with their marks, the last used marked, then Terminal, then In a new worktree…. While agents load, skeleton rows breathe and Terminal is ready; none found is one dim line naming the computer.
Dialogs: 24 inside, title 15 semibold, labels 12.5 muted, fields 30, footer at the right 8 apart: Cancel quiet, the action solid. Esc closes.
Create is disabled until there is a folder; the name follows the folder until typed. Pressed, the dialog closes and the row appears at once with the breathing dot.

A refused write keeps the dialog with the failure block under the fields: the tool's words, Create, Explain to <agent>; the footer keeps Cancel. "Already a project" and "already checked out" offer Go to it, Open it.
The worktree's folder shows in mono before creating; git's refusal uses the same block.
Cost: one command in that computer's shell when the menu opens.
kansō's dialog, opened from + → Add computer… and a computer's menu. It runs hc machine add. The word is computer, never machine.
Hosts from ~/.ssh/config as rows of 32: server icon, name, ssh target in mono dim, Add as a small tonal button. A typed user@host goes in the field below; Enter adds.
Add shows Added at once with the done mark. A refusal clears it and puts the failure block under that host: ssh's words, the fitting action (Sign in, or Add) and Explain to <agent>.
After a Mac is added it says it will ask before agents read Documents, with a button to that setting. No hosts: one sentence; the field is the action.
Cost: the ssh config is local; each Add is one ssh connection.
The held row stays in place on the pressed wash (w12); the drop point is a 2 px accent line at a row's top or bottom. No ghost.
Projects move within their computer only; elsewhere no line is drawn.
Agents drag in any order. The first drop switches the project to Your order and the sort icon turns foreground. Pinned rows move among the pinned.
A pane dropped over the sidebar returns where it was.
Cost: a drop writes a label (pins) or a preference.
One ring: the kit focus ring, 2 px accent outside the row. The selection wash stays where it was.
It walks every row in screen order: computers, projects, agents, sub-agents, asleep rows.
Keys: j k or ↓ ↑ move, gg G go to the ends, Enter or l runs the row's first action, Esc returns to the pane you came from, / opens find.
The ring leaves when the list loses the keyboard. No on-screen hint; keys live in Settings · Keys and the palette.
The kit menu: 252 wide, rows 30, icons 14 muted, an 11.5 dim head naming what was clicked. Hints at the right in dim.
Twelve rows at most. Snooze, Move to project and Copy open a short submenu (›). Sleep the project lives in the project's menu. Settle appears on Threads only.
Every menu ends with the piece lines: Hide “…” and Settings for this….
Close agent and Remove project arm in place ("Press again …", accent, 4 s) and the menu stays open. Remove says how many tabs close.
Words: New conversation, Sleep the project, Wake all 3 in review.
A computer's menu: Rename, Turn off, Sync, New project, Add computer. The asleep row's menu leads with Wake; Everything asleep… opens the Sleep dialog.
One row: Settings, 32, gear 17 muted, 13.5 text, 8 above and 16 below. The block is its rows (56; 88 with an update row).
Settings opens the kit menu (252, rows 30): kansō settings (⌃⇧,) and Herdr settings. Herdr's logo is not an icon in the footer or rail.
The footer reads the same in Stable Mode and Dawn Mode.
An update is one row above Settings, in foreground: "Update kansō to 3.31.0" with the refresh icon, or in Dawn Mode "Update to 3.31.0-beta.3".
Update is one press: the row reads "Updating kansō" in muted until it lands. Refused, the row returns with the failure block under it: the tool's line, Update and Explain to <agent>.
When a Herdr update waits, a third row "Update Herdr to 0.1.16" follows a rule. It restarts the window, so it arms first ("Press again to restart Herdr", 4 s); terminals stay.
No account chip. Add computer is in the + menu.
Cost: none; the update check belongs to the tab bar.
First read is the kit skeleton at 32, breathing: projects and their agents. Rows replace it without jumps.
No project: one dim sentence and New project.
Under 240 wide rows keep their first line only; a branch truncates first; the switch keeps its three words at 12.5. Under 160 the sidebar folds to the rail and reopens at the width you had.
Cost: none.
Width 76. The first 48 are the lights, with the Dawn Mode band (56 high) behind them.
Show-sidebar first (its 32 square starts at 50), then + 8 below, both 32 with 17. The view switch keeps its place without the blocked dot.

The list starts 8 below the switch. A project is a 40 tile, radius 6, 4 apart, its initial 13.5 strong 2 above its count 11.5. A computer is its 15 icon; a remote one is dim while unreadable, its projects folded under it. This computer has no glyph. Before a remote computer a 24 hairline in border at 50%, taking no height.

Each project keeps its app colour (avatarColor from assignColors: ansi6, ansi3, ansi4, ansi5, ansi2, ansi1, least used first, kept in space.colors). ansi6 has no token, so it mixes blue and done half and half. A kept project with nothing open stays muted.
An unread or woken row is a foreground count.
Footer square: Settings only, opening the settings menu. 56 high; 88 with an update row.
No program icon or working mark on tabs. A mark shows only for Needs you, and Finished until seen (piece tabs.marks).
× on the active tab at rest. On a tab holding an agent the first press arms for 4 s: accent in its own box, tooltip "Press again to close <name>". A plain shell closes on one press.
Double-click renames in place, name selected. Enter keeps, Esc restores.
Drag: the held tab on the pressed wash (w12), a 2 px accent bar where it lands.
A rename on another computer draws at 80% with a breathing dot until confirmed; refused, the old name returns with a toast.
No " Z" after a zoomed tab; the zoomed pane's header holds Unzoom.
Tabs that do not fit fold into +5, a menu with their marks. + and Arrange sit outside the scroller.
Connecting: one breathing skeleton per known tab. Unreachable: tabs at 55%, no +.
Remote: 0 calls at rest; tabs come over the core's link.

Bar 48, px 12, no fill. Tab 26 tall, 8 inside, 8 between icon, name and mark, text 12.5, icon 15, mark 14, name up to 170; 2 between tabs, 8 to + and Arrange. Panel buttons 26, 2 apart; the last 12 from the edge.
Panel button: 26 square, icon 15, hover w7, open w12. The name and key are the tooltip. A closed button paints nothing.
No ? or gear in the tab bar. Settings opens from the footer; ⌘⇧/ still opens Keys.
Drag to reorder: pressed wash and the accent bar, as tabs.
Panels is where a hidden panel comes back: a check means shown, ⌃⇧N in bar order, rows drag to reorder. Hiding unmounts the panel and stops its reads.
As the bar narrows: tab names to 120, then 72, then extra tabs into +N. Panel buttons, + and Arrange never fold.
Window buttons are icons in the same 26 button, right after the panel buttons.
Default order: Files, Spend, PR, Shipped, Worktrees, Ports, Containers, Memory, Images, then Simulator when a simulator tool exists. The user can drag to reorder.
Remote: 0. A hidden panel mounts nothing.
The kit menu (252, rows 30, radius 8).
The header names where the tab opens: the project, plus the computer when remote.
Only installed agents, keyed 1 to 9. New project is worded as everywhere.

Checking again keeps the last list and spins a 12 ensō in the header. With no list yet, two skeleton rows. A timeout is the failure block: "Can't list agents on <computer>", the tool's words, Refresh and Explain to <agent>.
Worktree rows show only inside a repository. Arrange is the last row, ⌥⌘T.
Remote: one agent check per open; the last answer paints at once. 0 at rest.
Hover shows four tools: split right, width, close and ⋯ (the pane menu with pin, open with, split down and send). 26 buttons with 15, 2 apart.
A focused finished or idle pane keeps Sleep and Send visible. A blocked pane has no Send.
Blocked: the 40% blocked wash, the breathing bar and the mark; no "Needs you" words.
Header 34 tall, content centred.
Close arms when the pane holds an agent: × turns accent in its 26 box, tooltip "Press again to close <name>" (4 s).
Pinned is a 12 pin in dim after the name, and no grip.
The grip has no tooltip; the grab cursor says it.
Double-click renames in place.
The blocked bar breathes on battery too.
Moving a pane: every terminal in the tab becomes a card (icon 17, name 13.5). The held one is on the pressed wash; the target splits toward the pointer and shows the held pane in accent 25%.
On another computer the folder is shortened with that home (~/acme-shop). The computer name is not on every header.
Unreachable: name, icon and digest at 55%, no state mark, terminal at 55%.
GitHub not answering: the PR segment shows the failure line: mark, "Can't read #142", a small Refresh; the tool's words in the tooltip. A click opens the PR panel on the block.

34 tall, 12 left, 8 right, 8 between items, text 12.5, top radius 8, icon 15, name up to 260, folder and branch 11.5 with a 12 icon up to 220, mark 14, grip a 14 icon in a 20 box. Right side: tools, mark, grip.
Remote, per stop: git status --porcelain=v2 --branch and git diff --shortstat, plus one gh pr view per distinct branch. 0 at rest.

pages.page: Compositions/Pane header, folding as the pane narrows
guidelines: As the pane narrows: folder, then branch; then the tools fold into ⋯ (close stays out); then commits, files, the verdict word (#142 keeps its colour) and the PR segment; then close joins ⋯ and the name truncates.
Never folded: program icon, state mark, grip, ⋯.
A folded segment keeps its fact in the PR segment's tooltip, word for word.
Ten states with the header spacing of the pane header.
No dot beside the verdict. The verdict word carries the colour: blocked for failed, conflicts and changes requested; working for running and behind; done for ready.
Needs you: blocked wash, breathing bar and mark.
The shimmer stays, on battery too. No counting dots after a working name.
Remote: one gh pr view per distinct branch when an agent stops, and every 60 s only while a check is pending.
Opens under the focused pane's header, right-aligned, 420 wide.
A row shows the time only; the day is its group header.
Previous and Next are dim while there is nothing to move to.
A missing file is the failure block: "Can't read <agent>'s conversation", the path, Refresh, Explain to <agent>. No matches is the empty state with the search icon.
A plain shell gets the terminal's own search.
Remote: one read on open, then one when the agent stops or on Enter.

pages.page: Compositions/Menus of the bars and headers
guidelines: One menu for every right-click and popup in the bars: 252 wide, rows 30, radius 8, icons 14 muted, keys 11.5 dim, header 11.5 dim naming what was clicked. It replaces Herdr's tab menu and new-menu.
Order: the thing's actions, then the act that ends it, then the piece lines (Only when needed, Hide this, Settings for this…).
An act that ends agents arms for 4 s and names them: "Press again to close 2 agents".
Pane menu: grouped by kind with headers. Split left with ⌥⌘⇧D. One checked row "Right-clicks go to the program". Find in conversation and Sleep included. Rows that cannot act are not drawn.
Separators come from groups, not row index.
Keys: j k gg G Enter Esc. Nothing is chosen until you move.
Remote: 0.
No branch on the status bar.

The computer name (piece status.computer, default Only when needed) shows only while its sidebar row is out of sight; "Can't reach <computer>" with a small Refresh while a pane of it is in front. A click reconnects; pending draws at 80% with a breathing dot.
Needs you (status.needs, default Only when needed) shows while any agent waits: mark, name, question, +1. Same words and cut as the row. Click: ⌘J.
Working count (status.agents, default Only when needed) shows only while one works; a click opens Status.
Memory is this computer's guard file, read every 60 s.

Fold order, right half: the palette key, then the count to its number, then servers, containers and reviews to icons, then the question, then Memory to "8% free". The name and +1 never fold. Left: the computer becomes its icon.
26 tall, 12 inside, 16 between items, text 11.5, icons 14 with 8 between, mark 14. Two halves around the fixed 180 minimap slot; each folds within (window − sidebar − 180) / 2.
Remote at rest: 0 for computer, needs you, count, memory, palette. Ports every 120 s and reviews at most every 120 s, window in front only. Hide stops them.
Edges show panes past them: chevron, then 20 tiles with the program icon. Click goes there; hover shows the name. No state dots.
No hover card.
A pane dragged over an edge washes it in accent 25%. Piece strip.edges, default Show.
Minimap (strip.minimap, default Show): a pill jumps to its column; the stepper sets panes per view. Focused column fg, in view muted, out of view input; stacks as 2 px cells.
The "− 2 +" stepper stays; tooltips show the key (⌘⇧−). Its right-click menu adds the same choice as a segmented control, and Even out.
"Layout paused" is the failure line with a small Resume; it resumes alone after 10 s.
Remote: 0.
Popover, radius 8, kit shadow. 360 × 40, mark 14, one sentence 12.5, at most one action word 12.5 medium. Up to three stacked, newest at the bottom.
A click goes to the fact. A word shows only for a different act: Undo, Update, Refresh, Restart, Open, Show, What's new.

A failure toast: the blocked mark, what failed in our words, one small fix button (Refresh, the write's name, Undo for a stuck sleep); the tool's words in the tooltip. No Explain. Same words as the block.
A toast echoes a fact only when its home is out of sight: no header shows that PR; the footer row is off screen; the Asleep group is off screen.
In Dawn Mode toasts do not name the channel.
A computer that drops is said once, by this toast.
Share with nothing copied: one sentence naming the file and the post.
"Already a project" and "already has a worktree" are said in the dialogs, not toasts.
One update checker: kanso-tabs/update.js polls and installs. The footer row reads the shared kanso.update state and its press runs kanso-tabs.update.
One sentence per toast.
System notifications only while no kansō window is on screen; otherwise the same words as a toast. Memory uses "Memory 8% free".
Pieces: toast.agent, toast.pr, toast.update, toast.memory, and guard.notify for system ones; all default Show.
Remote: 0.

guidelines: Header 40: title 20 (15 under 340), at most two context icons, Refresh last; its tooltip says when it was read. A page inside a panel puts ‹ before its title.
Scope line 11.5 dim. A stale read replaces it ("Read 14:02 · devbox unreachable · next try 14:07"); the body drops to 55% and writes are disabled.
Period: the kit segmented control with a two-button stepper at its right; a past period adds Now. Under 340 the stepper moves to the number's line.
Section: title 15, then at its right one dim fact or one quiet link (Clean up 1, Stop 2). Never a count of the rows below.

Row: name 12.5 (truncates), value at the right 12.5 tabular, meta under the name 11.5 dim, optional mark first. Without meta it is 32 high. Hover 7% wash; selected shows its actions line: at most one primary, the rest quiet, a removal arms. Built as prow2 plus pbx-v.
More: "Show 4 more" as a quiet link. A closed fold carries its summary at the right.
First read: skeleton shaped like the rows. Empty: one muted line. Error: the tool's words in blocked, with Refresh.
Share is one menu from the header icon. A panel whose tool is missing does not exist.
Keys: j k gg G Enter Esc r. Enter runs the selected row's first action.

pages.page: Panels/First screens: only what you would miss
guidelines: At rest a panel drops facts that repeat or say nothing now: scope lines, second lines, labels, marks and colour. They return under the pointer or keyboard. Every action stays visible and one press away; failures stay loud.

Folder, branch, files and lines live in the pane header, so panels drop their scope lines. Header icons, the period switch, Reply and Comment fields, Everyone's, Explain, Remove all and Prune all stay.
At rest a panel shows what you would miss; the rest appears when it needs you, changed, or has the pointer or keyboard.
Header icons appear with the pointer in the panel or keyboard focus. One qualifier (the month, the device, 1 of 3, another computer) sits beside the title in dim.
Second lines appear on pointer or selection. Folds keep only their word.
Colour only on what asks: a stopped container, an agent that needs you, a size past the guard's limit, your own pins.
Failure, empty and pending screens are unchanged.

The kit menu (252) from the header share icon in Ports, Memory, Spend and the hjkl dōjō. Its header states what is shared: "Counts and sizes only" (Ports, Memory), "Totals and days only" (Spend), "Scores and practice days only" (dōjō, after a round).
The icon shows only when there is something to share.
While the image is made, that row says so and the others dim; the result is a toast.
Cost: none until chosen; then a local render. The post opens in the browser.
One pin wherever a picture shows: Simulator (iOS and Android), Images, Preview pictures. Same marks, note, list and Send.

On a live picture (Simulator) the Pin tool or ⌥P freezes the frame; the scope line says "frozen at 14:06:12" and a 2 px focus ring marks the mode. The tool again or Esc returns to live. In Images and Preview the pin is always on.
A click drops a numbered pin; a drag draws a numbered region.
The note is typed beside its mark: click, type, Enter. A click on a mark edits it; Backspace on an empty note removes it.

The list under the picture is the message, one line per mark; × on hover removes one. Send to <agent> (the pane in front), ⌘↩; with none, Send to… opens the picker. After: "Sent to <agent> 14:07", marks clear, the picture goes live.
Unsent marks are kept per agent and picture; the scope line says "kept from 13:52 · not sent". A rotation or device change is said once.
To an agent on another computer the frame is copied first. Failures use the failure block with Send.
Cost: freezing reads no new file. Sending: one hc send; remote adds one frame copy (about 300 KB).
A panel that needs a tool exists only where the tool does: docker for Containers, xcrun simctl or adb for Simulator, macOS or Windows for Memory. Without it: no button, no Settings row, no job.
The probe runs at window start and when Settings opens, so installing a tool brings its panel back without a restart.
For a remote project Containers follows that computer's docker; Simulator and Memory stay local.
Each surface's main state in the light theme, same tokens.
Pictures and the device screen sit on raised inside the background slab.
The armed Stop is accent on accent_foreground in both themes.
Header: Files, then the quiet words Changed and All files, then Refresh. No scope line.
Opened from the digest's files segment it lands on Changed; from the tab bar, on the last view used. Outside a repository there is only the tree.

Files the focused agent named come first, newest first. A named file that also changed carries its stat there and is not listed again. Named files that did not change sit on one dim line, each a link. Also changed holds the rest. Only for an agent pane with a conversation (piece files.named; Hide stops the transcript read).
No totals; each row carries its own stat.
Modified has no mark. A and D sit dim where the file icon goes; U is blocked. A folder shows how many changed files it holds.
Rows 32, 12.5, 16 per level. j k move, Enter opens, Esc returns to the pane.
A row opens the file in Preview. Its stat (+14 −3) opens the diff. Right-click: Open the diff, Open, Open with…, Copy path.
The 500-per-folder cap is a dim row inside the folder it cut. An unreadable folder says so in its place.
Remote: none locally (a folder watch). On another computer, one tree read per open folder, then one stat every 5 s in front, 30 s after three quiet reads, none hidden.
First read: skeleton rows at 32. Later reads keep the rows and spin Refresh.
Errors are the folder's own words in blocked, with Refresh.
Stale takes the scope slot: "Read 14:02 · devbox unreachable · next try 14:03", rows at 55%.
A pane with no folder says so.
Narrow: title 15; the folder truncates before the name.
Light: only U is coloured.

pages.page: Panels/Preview: a text file, one save
guidelines: Header: ‹ only when opened from Files or Images, the file name as the 20 title with its folder dim beside it (full path on hover). Icons: Open with and ✕. Esc closes. Code in ink, literals muted.
Save (⌘S) appears only while there is an edit, as the one solid button. Saving… holds its place, then "Saved" for 2 s. Nothing autosaves.
Never "Press again": ⌘S saves, ⌘Z undoes; what could lose text offers Undo after.
No Refresh: with no edit open the file follows the disk.
Changed on disk while edited: one line with the time, Overwrite (also ⌘S) and Reload. Either leaves Undo (and ⌘Z) until the next edit.
Computer gone: the edit stays, the line says so, and it saves when the computer answers.
Over 1 MB: the first 1 MB, read only, ending "Cut at 1 MB".
Binary and missing files say what they are, with the action that still works.
Remote: one read to open, one write per Save, one stat every 5 s in front, 30 s after three quiet stats, none hidden.
A click on a block edits it in place (raised slab, focus ring). A click on a link follows it.
Clicking under the last block adds a paragraph.
Source is a header icon that stays lit while on; its text is the file as written.
Tables edit cell by cell. Add row, Add column and Remove row are quiet links under the table; Done closes. Esc closes any block.
Save: ⌘S or the button, never automatic.
Headings 20 and 15, body 13.5, code 11.5 on w7.

pages.page: Panels/Preview: pictures, and the Load step
guidelines: Pictures use the one pin component, always on: a click drops a numbered pin, a drag a region, the note is typed beside it. Send to <agent> or ⌘↩, then "Sent to <agent> 14:07".
The pixel size shows on hover, beside the folder. The picture fits the width on canvas, radius 8.
Load is the one solid button with the size: "Load 4.2 MB".
Loading keeps the picture's frame, breathing.
Over 20 MB says what stops it, with Open with….
Inside a note, a picture to load is one row: name, size, Load.
Remote: one stat for the size. Under 2 MB the copy starts at once; over 2 MB it waits for Load.

pages.page: Panels/Pull requests: one list, by project
guidelines: The panel lists open pull requests that concern you. No Closed tab, no merged rows. A merge is an event in While you were away.
Asked of you comes first, across every repository. Repository and who asked show on hover or keyboard focus.
Then one group per sidebar project, in sidebar order, the front pane's project first. Everyone's in <repo>, a quiet link under the group, opens the others' pull requests.

Inside a group: changes requested or failed check, running, ready, draft. A row is number, title and one word at the right, coloured only when it asks for you (failed, failing, changes, review, blocked).

The branch in front without a pull request gets the group's first row: the branch, its one fact (2 commits not on GitHub, 3 behind GitHub, no pull request) and one action: Push, Pull or Create pull request. Create is a page: title from the last commit, body, Create or Create as draft. No row on the default branch.
A pane not in git leaves the list as is.
The branch in front with an open pull request opens on it, titled #142, with ‹ back: verdict, failing log lines, Explain to <agent> and Full log, then the Conversation. ‹ or Esc returns to the list.
GitHub is the header's icon; on a failed check Open log on GitHub sits beside Full log.
Rows 32. The full state, repository, who asked and age show as a second line on hover or focus.

Remote: one GraphQL read per GitHub host, made locally, shared with the status bar's "2 reviews": at most every 120 s, window in front and the panel or item on screen, honouring GitHub's retry time. "Everyone's" is one gh pr list when opened, kept until Refresh.
On another computer GitHub is still read locally; only Push and Pull call the remote computer.
The list on background; log, threads and fields on canvas. State colours stay the state's.

pages.page: Panels/Pull requests: every state of the list
guidelines: First read: skeleton in the list's shape. Later reads keep the rows and spin Refresh.
Empty: "Nothing open"; with a branch row above it, "Nothing else open".
Signed out and GitHub CLI missing are the only whole-panel states. Sign in opens gh auth login in a pane to the right.
Rate limited and not answering use the stale line, last rows at 55%. Nothing retries before GitHub's retry time.
Remote project: the branch row names the computer and Pull runs there. Unreachable dims only that row.
"Everyone's" loads in place: your rows stay and the others breathe below.
A pull request that asks you opens on Your review: one field, Approve, Request changes, Comment.
A merged pull request leaves the list; its branch row says "#139 merged 14:20" until the branch changes, and offers Create pull request.
The branch's pull request paints at once from the header's read; only the card breathes.

pages.page: Panels/A pull request: every state says why
guidelines: Every non-mergeable state says why on the card, in its source's words, with Explain to <agent>. One press sends the card text and the PR URL to that agent; the button's place then says "Sent to <agent> 14:07".
Explain to <agent> hands over a reason the app found. Send to <agent> is for your own words.
The agent is the one on that branch's pane; otherwise the front pane's agent. With no agent, Explain is absent, never disabled.
Waits have no Explain: draft (its action is Ready for review), checks running, "Checking whether it can merge".
Behind its base: Update branch is the primary; Explain is quiet beside it.
Nothing ends in "Open on GitHub".

Sources, all from the one gh pr view on open or Refresh: mergeStateStatus and mergeable (state); statusCheckRollup (each check and its run); reviewDecision, reviewRequests, latestReviews (who was asked, who can merge); viewerPermission; baseRef.branchProtectionRule with head commit signatures (unmet rules; unreadable shows "Blocked by branch rules").

Local git on the branch's computer, once when the state turns: conflicting files (git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only) and missing commits (git log HEAD..origin/main). Failed logs: one gh run view --log-failed per failure, cached.
Running checks re-read every 20 s only while the panel is open and in front.

pages.page: Panels/A pull request: sending, writing, elsewhere
guidelines: Every detail page has ‹ back to the list.
When the pane's agent is blocked, Explain is absent and the verdict adds "· <agent> needs you first".
Explain sends on one press; afterwards its place says "Sent to <agent> 14:07".
Full log is a page in the panel from the --log-failed text already read.
A refused write: gh's words where the actions were, the action's name to retry, then Explain.
Writing: the button keeps its size with "Merging…" and Refresh spins.

Remote project: GitHub is read and written locally; Explain goes to the remote agent. Remote unreachable: "Not sent: <computer> unreachable" with Explain to retry. GitHub down: the stale line, writes disabled.
Narrow: title 15; the fold note drops the people count first.
Remote: a write is one gh call plus one re-read. Explain is local.

pages.page: Panels/A pull request: Details open, and the pickers
guidelines: Details order: Description, People and labels, Checks, Unresolved threads (if any), Files, then Back to draft and Close. Sections are titles only.
A people row opens its picker.

Every write is optimistic: a click marks the row pending at once and the next click lands immediately. Changes leave together 600 ms after the last click as one gh api graphql request with aliased mutations. Confirmed, the check goes full. Refused, the row reverts with gh's words and a retry. Closing never cancels the queue. Offline, the queue keeps and says so once.
Picker lists come from the local store at once; the skeleton shows only on a repository's first open. Refreshed at most once per open (labels or assignableUsers, 100).
Store: kdb.js tables pr_items, pr_fetches, pr_candidates (labels and people per repository) and pr_writes (the queue).
Truncation is said: "First 100 of 132".
Files use the Files row; a row opens the diff.
Back to draft and Close: one press each, quiet, below a rule, then Undo. Merge is the only second press in this panel.
Remote at rest: zero.

pages.page: Panels/A pull request: a file's diff, and comments on its lines
guidelines: A click on a diff line, or the + in its number's place on hover, opens a comment field under it. On your own pull request Comment (⌘↵) posts at once (addPullRequestReviewThread). When your review is asked, the button is Add to review: the comment waits pending and goes with the review.
Threads sit under their line with their Reply field.

A diff page: file name as title; PR, folder and stat as scope; Open in Preview and Open on GitHub as icons. Lines 20, mono 11.5; additions and removals washed done and blocked at 12%. Files opens the same page for local changes.
No text diff: one line. Over 400 lines: see the long diff page.
Remote: one gh pr diff per pull request, local, cached until it changes.

pages.page: Panels/A pull request: the conversation and the review, in the panel
guidelines: Every review step happens in the panel. GitHub is only the header icon.

Conversation sits under the verdict. Each unresolved thread: author, path:line, the comment in full; your replies fold to "1 reply, yours". Reply, Resolve and Explain are always there; on hover the three lines around it show. Then reviews and comments oldest first, and the Comment field.
Resolve is one press and leaves one line with Undo. When the agent answers an Explain, its words fill that thread's field, marked "<agent> answered 14:21"; ⌘↵ posts.
With changes requested, the reviewer's thread is the body; no separate card.
Asked of you: Files, then Your review: one field with Approve, Request changes and Comment. Pending line comments go in the same submit.
Writes are optimistic: pending at once, full when confirmed. Refused, it comes back out, the field keeps the text, gh's words show under it with Reply. Offline, it waits, said once.

gh calls: Reply addPullRequestReviewThreadReply; Resolve and Undo resolveReviewThread and unresolveReviewThread; Comment gh pr comment --body-file -; Review gh pr review --approve, --request-changes or --comment; with line comments one POST repos/{o}/{r}/pulls/{n}/reviews.
At rest, zero polls; everything rides the reads made on open and Refresh. After a write, one re-read.

pages.page: Panels/A pull request: a long diff
guidelines: A long diff draws 400 lines; the scope says "lines 1 to 400". Below: how many remain and Show the next 400, with no new read.
Header scope is the period (This week). Under it the segmented Day · Week · Month · Year with ‹ and ›. Share and Refresh are header icons.
Hero: the 48 metric: lines added, lines removed muted, then the change in words with an arrow, muted.
Counts are one dim line: PRs merged, commits, reviews, streak. On a Day, Contributions leads.
A click on the streak opens the heat map. Longest streak is in Records.
At rest only a new record shows ("new"). Records, When you ship and Computers are one row each and open on click. Charts in ink (foreground at 25 to 100%), never accent.
By repository: top 3, then Show 8 more. Commits on hover.
Rows use the one row with the value at the right, 12.5 foreground.
Remote: one GitHub GraphQL read per period on open or Refresh. Line sums from git per computer, read once then incrementally. No poll.

pages.page: Panels/Shipped: reading, empty, signed out, share
guidelines: First read: skeleton in the hero's shape. Later reads keep the numbers and spin Refresh.
Adding up: the hero says "lines so far"; the count left is in Refresh's tooltip.
Empty: one line naming the period.
Not signed in and GitHub CLI missing use the PR panel's words and actions.
GitHub not answering: the stale line, last numbers at 55%.
Share is a menu with one header line (totals only). A network being prepared dims while the image is made.
The card is an SVG drawn to PNG: ink, no accent, the done ensō and "kansō for Herdr" at the foot.
Share is disabled until the first read lands.
Header icons: + (new worktree), Share, Refresh. No scope locally; a remote computer names itself.
Hero: one metric and one primary, "Clean up 3 · 1.1 GB", with Explain to <agent> beside it. Freed is one row at the end.
What Clean up takes is said once, when armed.
Groups are repositories, open, with Show more, Remove all and Prune as quiet links; then Left behind.
A row is one line: name and size. The verdict shows only when it needs you (uncommitted changes, broken link) or on hover. Selecting a row shows its consequence, path and actions.
A worktree open in a tab offers Go to <tab>.
Armed Remove, Remove all and Clean up use accent.

A group with two or more removable worktrees ends with Remove all 3 beside Show 2 more. Armed, the loss line sits above the links: what is lost in blocked, or "Nothing is lost." muted, then "Merged branches go too." Open, locked, in-use-today or unchecked worktrees are never taken.
Over eight repositories, "Show 3 more repositories" follows the eighth.
Colour only for uncommitted changes and a broken link.
Explain to <agent>: a worktree in a tab goes to that tab's agent; otherwise the front pane's.
Freed is one row; its 30-day bars open from it.

pages.page: Panels/Worktrees: scanning, failing, elsewhere, and a new one
guidelines: Scan progress takes the scope slot ("checking 12 of 40"). The first scan uses the skeleton; later scans keep the last result with Clean up disabled until done.
Empty: "No worktrees".
Scan failure sits where the list starts, with Refresh and Explain. A refused removal sits on its row with Remove and Explain.
The panel follows the focused project's computer; every command runs there. Unreachable: the stale line, writes disabled.

New worktree is the sidebar's dialog: title 15 semibold, branch field focused, the folder as a live fact under it, the agent to start (last used preselected), Create solid, Cancel quiet, Enter and Esc. Opened from + here and "New agent in a worktree…" on the project row.
Remote: one scan per open or Refresh on the computer in scope. No poll. Create is one git worktree add and a new tab.
Header icons appear with the pointer or keyboard focus. No scope line; a remote computer is named beside the title. Second lines and row actions appear on hover or selection.
No pane first, as that section's title; rows in panes follow after a gap, each named by its pane.
No hero.

A row is one line: port, what runs it (one word, or the pane's name) and size. On hover or selection the second line shows command, folder and age, and the actions: No pane rows have Stop as the primary; pane rows have three quiet links, Go to first.
Stop and Stop 2 arm "Press again" in accent, 4 s. A failed stop says so in blocked and offers Force stop.
The status bar's ":6006 no pane" opens here with that row selected and Stop focused.
Chart, history and share sit behind History, closed; its range is the segmented control. Its summary shows when open.
Share is a header menu, "Counts and sizes only".
The focused project's computer decides what is read. Unreachable keeps the last read at 55%, Stop disabled.
Under 340: title 15, the command hides, "Open in the browser" becomes "Open".
Cost: in front, one lsof + ps every 30 s. Behind or closed: none. Remote: one listener read (about 1 KB) every 60 s, ps only when the ports change. History is one file read when opened.
Share, Refresh: shown with the pointer in the panel or keyboard focus.
Scope: only a remote computer's name, beside the title.
No pane: no coloured dot; the title says it.
Stop 2: on hover of the No pane title.
Command, folder, age: the row's second line on hover or selection.
What runs it: one word (storybook, next); the full command on hover.
In a pane: no section title; the rows after the gap name their pane.
Program icon: on hover.
History summary: the first line of History when opened.

Header icons appear with the pointer or keyboard focus. No scope line; a remote computer or Docker context is named beside the title, its address on hover. Second lines and row actions on hover or selection.

Updates (Stable Mode | Dawn Mode) and the version line with Refresh sit above. No automatic-check switch, Check button or waiting banner.

The Simulator is kansō's own code since 3.31.0; no herdr-sim row.
No avatars; nothing is downloaded.

Popover, radius 8, padding 24, 480 wide (popups 340). Title 15 semibold naming the thing (Rename <name>). Optional scope line, 11.5 dim. No paragraph, no label over a lone field.
Footer right-aligned: at most one solid primary (30, radius 6) and quiet links. Esc and a click outside close; if a click outside cannot close, Cancel returns as a quiet link.
24 inside on all four sides; panels keep 16. No fixed height: it ends 24 under its last line. Settings scrolls only past 680.
A focused field wears the focus ring. Armed: "Press again to …", accent, 4 s.

First read: skeleton. Pending: on its row, 80% with the breathing dot. Failure: the source's words in blocked (two lines, full text in the tooltip), then the retry (Refresh, or the action's name) and Explain to <agent>. Empty: one dim sentence, one action at most. Classes: pax-fail, pax-empty, pax-skl, pax-ck pend.
Rename: the placeholder is the program's own name (claude).
The Pin note is kanso-prompt with lines: 4.
Remote: one hc label on the terminal's computer, or one shared write.
Sleep an agent or tab is one press: the moon on the focused finished pane, or the tab's menu. The tab leaves, a toast offers Undo for 8 s, and the row enters Asleep breathing.

Sleep a project opens a dialog only when something will not come back as it was, and says only that: "vite on web starts fresh on Wake". Otherwise it sleeps at once. The primary counts: Sleep 3 tabs. A remote computer is named in the title.
A blocker is the row's fact ("working" with its mark) and one blocked line. The dialog re-reads every 3 s; when the agent stops, it sleeps.

No Asleep dialog; states live on the group's rows: Going to sleep and Waking (pending, moon breathes, word dim), stuck (failure on the row with Undo, no Explain), asleep (Wake, Enter wakes), unreachable (dim, no Wake). Wake all and Forget are in the row's menu; Forget arms in accent.

Stuck sentences from sleepwork.js: "<agent> did not exit", "<agent>'s prompt could not be cleared", "<agent>'s conversation was not found". The toast uses the same words with Undo, only when the group is off screen.
Folded group: the count, plus "· 1 stuck" in blocked. Open: no count.
Remote: one session file per agent on that computer, once, then every 3 s only while blocked.
The dialog shell. One line per arrangement, no icon. A row from another project names it at the right. Panes in the tooltip.
Overwrite and Delete on the selected row. Enter opens. Delete arms in accent.
Save shows the tab's shape (columns at their widths, each pane's program and command). An agent says "new conversation".
Typing a used name turns the primary into "Overwrite <name>", which takes a second press.
Opening is pending on its row and the tab appears. A refused delete shows the tool's words under the row, then Delete and Explain to <agent>.
Empty: "No arrangement" and the primary.
Remote: none to read (local store). Opening remotely starts each pane there (one hc call per pane).
The dialog shell. No scope line, no To or Message labels. Find shows with more than six agents.
A row: agent name, its project as one dim word, its ensō. The branch on hover.
An agent that needs you is not offered.
A press on a project word selects every agent there. The primary names the target: Send to <agent>, Send to 2 in <project>.
Esc closes.
Remote: the dim word says it ("relay · devbox"). Unreachable rows dim, say so, and are not targets.
Sending is pending on the target row; the dialog closes when hc confirms. Refused: hc's words under that row; the draft stays.
With no target or an empty message there is no Send.
Remote: no reads. One hc send per target on that agent's computer.
Popup on the dialog shell: title 15 semibold, the path as scope (computer first when remote), rows 32 with the editor name only. Number keys 1 to 9 show once the keyboard moves in the list.
A terminal editor says "in a split" on hover. An editor that cannot open remotely is not drawn there.
No rule under the header, no Esc corner, no coloured letter tiles.
Looking: skeleton. None: one dim sentence. Failure: the probe's words, then Refresh; no Explain.
Remote: none. Editors are found locally once and cached in open-with.found; on another computer the editor opens over its own SSH.
The window uses the panel shell: header 40, title 20 (window 560), ‹ only when a file is open, Close last. Source and Refresh show with the pointer over the header.
The scope line carries the folder and the save state only while it matters ("Saving…", "Edited"), or the stale line, or "612 KB, read only".
Review: the scope line names who waits ("<agent> waits for your review"); Done is the one solid primary.
If telling md-review fails: the failure block under the scope with md-review's words, Done and Explain to <agent>. The header's Done hides meanwhile.
Refresh, with its tooltip saying when it was read.
Changed on disk while editing: "Changed on disk at 14:06", then Overwrite and Reload; after Overwrite, "Saved over the 14:06 text" with Undo.
List: Waiting for your review, From this terminal, In this folder, as sections without counts; rows 32. Empty: "No Markdown in <folder>".
Blocks keep their hover; a double-click edits. An editing block is the raised slab with the focus ring. A table edits as its grid.
The same MarkdownDoc as Preview, with the same words.
Remote: one stat every 10 s while the window shows, a full read only when size or mtime changes. Nothing while hidden. The list is read once, on open.
At rest a dialog shows what you came for and what you would miss; the rest appears on hover, keyboard focus, change or need. Failure, armed and blocked stay as loud.
Colour only for the solid primary, a focused field's accent, an agent's ensō, and working on what will not come back.
kansō settings has no header link to Herdr settings. Keys folds its list into eight group lines under the keyboard. What's new has no version line or Refresh.
Sleep a project says only what will not come back. Send lists only agents that can take the text. Arrangements, Open with and Credits have no row icons.
The grid: 18 × 8 cells of 34, centred. The cursor is the solid cell. The target: accent ring, accent wash and a dot. After a miss the best path shows as a trail with its first key ("l"), after 2 s.
Round progress is ten segments on the grid's top edge, the current one half lit.
One quiet line above the grid: score, time, streak, then "2 moves · this one takes 5 at best". Over the best the count turns working.
Hachi speaks in a bubble on raised beside it. The face follows the mood (calm, glad, sweat, sleep); the bubble edge takes its colour (glad done, sweat working). Hachi's 16 × 15 art is the code's own.
The real keyboard under the grid, four staggered rows. The level's keys are raised, the rest ghosts. Finger names once under h j k l. The pressed key lights; the hinted key takes the accent ring.
Levels are a path: done is a filled node with its best, current ringed and washed, untried hollow. [ and ] move along it; p opens the pet chooser outside a round. No level is locked.
Keys: a move starts a round, Enter plays again, n next level, Esc twice leaves. End round stays in the header for the mouse.
The result replaces the grid: score at 48, "a new best for level 3 · was 120" in done, one quiet line (targets, fewest, streak, time), then ↩ play again, n next level.
Level cleared: its node fills with the best; the next level is current, its tip in Hachi's words.
All nine done: the path is full with the total, Hachi glad.
Share is the one share menu, "Scores and practice days only", once a round is played.
Esc once: Hachi's bubble turns accent, "Press Esc again to leave the dōjō" (3 s, ARM_MS). A round ended early: "Round stopped, not counted."
After 20 s with no round: Hachi's sleep face and "z z".
Light tokens. Hachi keeps its fur and cream; tongue accent, sweat blue.
In light, Hachi's outline, eyes and nose use #161615 (mascot.js's fallback) so they stay visible.
